## Outline

- Where this is going next. Brief, non-breathless.
- Next step, if you want it: [ellmer](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org) calls the
  same models from your own R code, so a model can sit inside a script, a
  Shiny app or a pipeline. It needs an API key of its own, which is why it
  isn't used today.
- Where the materials live and how to keep going.
- Feedback survey.
- Answer the abstract's closing question.
